_about: The route map's places from the field notebooks, as a guide uses them (owner, 20.11). k: extra layers (view = תצפיות, urban = עירוני ותרבות); p: period ids (periods.json), which put a place on the history layer; r: religions, which put it on the religious-sites layer; t: 'מה מספרים כאן', two or three talking points, written from the notebook's account of the place. Every place sits on at least one layer.
